text.p: The monthly meeting on Wednesday between Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Governor of the Bank of England Eddie George has ended, a Treasury official told Reuters.
George was still at the Treasury when the Bank offered routine assistance to money market operators at midday. It subsequently bought bills at an unchanged rate of 5-15/16 percent.
This means the result of the meeting is likely to be signalled in the next round of operations at 1400 GMT or in the first round of operations on Thursday morning.
